scope: Electoral rules for the 2026-2027 Chihuahua local election process. The electoral documents do not establish the status of the separate heritage bill or community and government relationships.

events.detail: The Guadalajara regional ruling records N’dee/N’nee/Ndé self-identification by some of the petitioners and directs electoral measures under stated conditions.

The state electoral institute approved reduced voter-support thresholds for qualifying Indigenous independent candidates under Section 5. The order cites the Guadalajara case and separate local electoral proceedings.
